rule: every identity evaluated wherever it applies, on cells whose two reads agree; held within n half-units of the printed precision for n printed values

identities.description: Total Europe equals sum of European countries
identities.equation: total_europe = austria + belgium_luxembourg + bulgaria + czechoslovakia + denmark + finland + france + german_democratic_republic + germany + greece + hungary + italy + netherlands + norway + poland + portugal + romania + spain + sweden + switzerland + turkey + united_kingdom + ussr + yugoslavia + other_europe

identities.description: Total Latin America and Caribbean equals sum of its countries
identities.equation: total_latin_america_caribbean = argentina + bahamas + bermuda + brazil + british_west_indies + chile + colombia + cuba + ecuador + guatemala + jamaica + mexico + netherlands_antilles + panama + peru + trinidad_tobago + uruguay + venezuela + other_latin_america_caribbean

identities.description: Total Asia equals sum of Asian countries
identities.equation: total_asia = mainland + taiwan + hong_kong + india + indonesia + israel + japan + korea + lebanon + malaysia + pakistan + philippines + singapore + syria + thailand + oil_exporting_asia + other_asia

identities.description: Total Africa equals sum of African countries
identities.equation: total_africa = egypt + ghana + liberia + morocco + south_africa + zaire + oil_exporting_africa + other_africa

identities.description: Total other countries equals Australia plus All other
Total foreign countries equals regional totals plus Canada
identities.equation: total_foreign_countries = total_europe + canada + total_latin_america_caribbean + total_asia + total_africa + total_other_countries

identities.description: Total international and regional equals sum of its components
identities.equation: total_international_regional = international + european_regional + latin_american_regional + asian_regional + african_regional + middle_eastern_regional

identities.description: Grand total equals Total foreign plus Total international
